decisions.reason: Underground LHD loaders demand heavy engineering, certification and dealer investment, and the firm has publicly committed to them, so one year on the market is too early to judge, and any weak results can be put down to long mining procurement cycles.

The underground dump truck rounds out the LHD line as a joint mining offering, so sunk development costs, its public presentation and its place in the announced mining direction favour keeping it while early sales are read as a temporary ramp-up.
